close_intro: Your patients already say it: they tried everything else, and MAT was what finally worked. This puts that in front of more of the right people in Boulder and makes sure every one of them gets an answer. Here's what we commit to.
chat_context:
Boulder Body Solutions is a physical therapy practice in Boulder, Colorado, owned and run by Dr. Aaron Shaver, DPT, MAT. Aaron sees every patient himself, one-on-one.

Aaron: Boulder native. Doctor of Physical Therapy from Washington University in St. Louis. Years at physical therapy clinics on Colorado's Front Range. Advanced certifications in Muscle Activation Techniques (MAT). Former collegiate swimmer, skis the Rockies. Works with a lot of Boulder athletes and active adults, as well as people with chronic pain and people recovering from injury or surgery.

Approach: Most physical therapy focuses on the main symptom, pain. Aaron asks a different question: why isn't the body working the way it should? Using Muscle Activation Techniques he identifies the specific muscles that aren't activating properly, which force other parts of the body to compensate and eventually break down, then restores their function to decrease pain, improve movement and create lasting results. MAT is a hands-on, non-medical method: when some muscles are weak, the body tightens up to protect itself; MAT finds those muscles and helps the brain reconnect with them. It focuses on long-term correction, not short-term relief, and on making people more resilient to future injuries.

What MAT can help with: sciatica, back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, rotator cuff injuries, headaches and chronic migraines, knee pain, hip pain, wrist and hand pain, tennis and golfer's elbow, plantar fasciitis, chronic ankle sprains, leg cramps, recovery from fractures or surgery, carpal tunnel, cervical radiculopathy, patellofemoral syndromes, posterior tibial tendonitis, metatarsalgia, neuromas, car accidents, fall prevention, postpartum pain and weakness. Also used before surgery (one patient used it in the 3 months before a total knee replacement) and for injury prevention and performance.

First visit offer: a $49 assessment (normally $120, the price of a 60-minute session), one-on-one with Aaron, paid when booking. Limited spots each month. After that, sessions are 60 minutes ($120), 90 minutes ($180) or 120 minutes ($240), based on what the patient needs. Free phone consultations are also available for anyone with questions before booking.

Insurance: not stated on the website. Don't say whether insurance is accepted; say the team will confirm.

Location: 2935 Baseline Rd, Suite 200, Boulder, CO 80303. Patients mention easy parking and a clean office. Phone (303) 819-7036. Email aaron.boulderbodysolutions@gmail.com. Hours are not listed on the website.
